decisions.reason: The multi-model electric infrared panel line is a flagship aligned with the firm's electrification direction, and with growth-driven slack and no reported shortfall against aspirations there is no trigger for problemistic search.

The single halogen heater is the most peripheral item and the likeliest candidate for pruning, but it rounds out the electric portfolio for spot and outdoor heating and shows no evident shortfall, so the expanding firm keeps carrying it.
This industrial electric hall heater line sits close to the core offer for logistics and industrial halls and likely performs at or above aspiration, so retaining it is the satisficing choice.
The hydrogen-capable dark radiant heater is a strategic flagship already in real operation, and slack from expansion lets the firm carry its uncertain but future-oriented results.
